context_for_next_testing_agent: Message Center Phase 1 (Institutional Messages) is fully functional. The MessageCenter component is integrated in DashboardPage.jsx (line 288) and CourseDetailPage.jsx (line 7241). Backend endpoints: POST/GET /api/messaging/institutional, POST /api/messaging/institutional/{id}/read, DELETE /api/messaging/institutional/{id}, GET /api/messaging/stats. Phase 2 (Support tickets) and Phase 3 (Academic messages) endpoints exist but were not tested as per requirements.

institutional_messages.list: Shows title, content preview, priority badge, date, unread indicator
institutional_messages.detail: Shows full content, author photo/name, date, priority badge
